这些辅助函数不会调用 Supervisor。它们用于处理值、文件和 JSON，其他 Bashio 函数也会使用它们。本页上的函数列表由 Bashio 源码中的 docblock 生成。描述文字就是源码中的描述，因此有些地方仍写着 "addon"，而本网站使用的是 app。

`bashio::var.*`、`bashio::fs.*` 和 `bashio::jq.is*` 函数是检查类函数：它们不打印任何内容，是则返回退出状态 `0`，否则返回 `1`。请在 `if` 中使用它们。

```bash
#!/command/with-contenv bashio

if ! bashio::fs.directory_exists '/data/db'; then
  mkdir -p /data/db
fi

config=$(bashio::var.json name "$(bashio::app.name)" port "^8080")
bashio::log.debug "${config}"

bashio::net.wait_for 3306 localhost 30
```

`bashio::var.json` 根据键值对构建 JSON 对象。值默认作为字符串处理，除非你以 `^` 开头：这样值会按原样传入，适用于数字、布尔值和嵌套 JSON。

## 变量

检查值，并将 shell 值转换为 JSON。来源：[`lib/var.sh`](https://github.com/hassio-addons/bashio/blob/main/lib/var.sh)。

- `bashio::var.true`: Checks if a given value is true.
  - `$1`: value
- `bashio::var.false`: Checks if a given value is false.
  - `$1`: value
- `bashio::var.defined`: Checks if a global variable is defined.
  - `$1`: Name of the variable
- `bashio::var.has_value`: Checks if a value has actual value.
  - `$1`: Value
- `bashio::var.is_empty`: Checks if a value is empty.
  - `$1`: Value
- `bashio::var.equals`: Checks if a value equals.
  - `$1`: Value
  - `$2`: Equals value
- `bashio::var.json`: Creates JSON based on function arguments.
  - `$@`: Bash array of key/value pairs, prefix integer or boolean values with ^
- `bashio::var.json_string`: Escapes a string for use in a JSON object.
  - `$1`: String to escape
- `bashio::var.json_array`: Converts a bash array to a JSON array.
  - `$@`: Bash array

## 字符串

修改和测量字符串。来源：[`lib/string.sh`](https://github.com/hassio-addons/bashio/blob/main/lib/string.sh)。

- `bashio::string.lower`: Converts a string to lower case.
  - `$1`: String to convert
- `bashio::string.upper`: Converts a string to upper case.
  - `$1`: String to convert
- `bashio::string.replace`: Replaces parts of the string with another string.
  - `$1`: String to make replacements in
  - `$2`: String part to replace
  - `$3`: String replacement
- `bashio::string.length`: Returns the length of a string.
  - `$1`: String to determine the length of
- `bashio::string.substring`: Returns a substring of a string.
  - `$1`: String to return a substring of
  - `$2`: Position to start
  - `$3`: Length of the substring (optional)

`bashio::string.substring` 的 docblock 中有如下示例：

```bash
stringZ=abcABC123ABCabc
bashio::string.substring "${stringZ}" 0      # abcABC123ABCabc
bashio::string.substring "${stringZ}" 1      # bcABC123ABCabc
bashio::string.substring "${stringZ}" 7      # 23ABCabc
bashio::string.substring "${stringZ}" 7 3    # 23A
```

## 文件

检查文件、文件夹、设备和套接字是否存在。来源：[`lib/fs.sh`](https://github.com/hassio-addons/bashio/blob/main/lib/fs.sh)。

- `bashio::fs.directory_exists`: Check whether or not a directory exists.
  - `$1`: Path to directory
- `bashio::fs.file_exists`: Check whether or not a file exists.
  - `$1`: Path to file
- `bashio::fs.file_non_empty`: Check whether or not a file exists and is non-empty (size > 0 bytes).
  - `$1`: Path to file
- `bashio::fs.device_exists`: Check whether or not a device exists.
  - `$1`: Path to device
- `bashio::fs.socket_exists`: Check whether or not a socket exists.
  - `$1`: Path to socket

## JSON

使用 jq 查询 JSON，并检查结果的类型。来源：[`lib/jq.sh`](https://github.com/hassio-addons/bashio/blob/main/lib/jq.sh)。

- `bashio::jq`: Execute a JSON query.
  - `$1`: JSON string or path to a JSON file
  - `$2`: jq filter (optional)
  - `$@`: Extra jq arguments, for example --arg/--argjson to pass values safely (optional)
- `bashio::jq.exists`: Checks if variable exists (optionally after filtering).
  - `$1`: JSON string or path to a JSON file
  - `$2`: jq filter (optional)
- `bashio::jq.has_value`: Checks if data exists (optionally after filtering).
  - `$1`: JSON string or path to a JSON file
  - `$2`: jq filter (optional)
- `bashio::jq.is`: Checks if resulting data is of a specific type.
  - `$1`: JSON string or path to a JSON file
  - `$2`: jq filter
  - `$3`: type (boolean, string, number, array, object, null)
- `bashio::jq.is_boolean`: Checks if resulting data is a boolean.
  - `$1`: JSON string or path to a JSON file
  - `$2`: jq filter (optional)
- `bashio::jq.is_string`: Checks if resulting data is a string.
  - `$1`: JSON string or path to a JSON file
  - `$2`: jq filter (optional)
- `bashio::jq.is_object`: Checks if resulting data is an object.
  - `$1`: JSON string or path to a JSON file
  - `$2`: jq filter (optional)
- `bashio::jq.is_number`: Checks if resulting data is a number.
  - `$1`: JSON string or path to a JSON file
  - `$2`: jq filter (optional)
- `bashio::jq.is_array`: Checks if resulting data is an array.
  - `$1`: JSON string or path to a JSON file
  - `$2`: jq filter (optional)

## 缓存

Supervisor API 函数使用的文件缓存，位于 `/tmp/.bashio`，除非你设置了 `CACHE_DIR`。来源：[`lib/cache.sh`](https://github.com/hassio-addons/bashio/blob/main/lib/cache.sh)。

- `bashio::cache.exists`: Check if a cache key exists in the cache
  - `$1`: Cache key
- `bashio::cache.get`: Returns the cached value based on a key
  - `$1`: Cache key
- `bashio::cache.set`: Cache a value identified by a given key
  - `$1`: Cache key
  - `$2`: Cache value
- `bashio::cache.flush`: Remove a specific item from the cache based on the caching key
  - `$1`: Cache key
- `bashio::cache.flush_all`: Flush all cached data

## 网络

等待 TCP 端口接受连接。无论成功与否，该函数都会在超时后返回，因此如果你的脚本依赖该端口，请再次检查。来源：[`lib/net.sh`](https://github.com/hassio-addons/bashio/blob/main/lib/net.sh)。

- `bashio::net.wait_for`: Wait for a TCP port to be available.
  - `$1`: Port to wait for
  - `$2`: Interface/host the port should bind to (optional, default: localhost)
  - `$3`: Timeout in seconds (optional, default: 60)

## Have I Been Pwned

对照 Have I Been Pwned 数据库检查密码。只有密码 SHA-1 哈希值的前五个字符会离开容器。来源：[`lib/pwned.sh`](https://github.com/hassio-addons/bashio/blob/main/lib/pwned.sh)。

- `bashio::pwned.is_safe_password`: Checks if a given password is safe to use.
  - `$1`: The password to check
- `bashio::pwned.occurrences`: Gets the number of occurrences of the password in the list.
  - `$1`: The password to check
- `bashio::pwned.occurances`: Deprecated alias for `bashio::pwned.occurrences.`
- `bashio::pwned`: Makes a call to the Have I Been Pwned password database
  - `$1`: The password to check
